_comment: The detector's class list. Order IS the class index: index 0 is the first entry. Append only -- never reorder or delete, or every label file and trained weight silently changes meaning. A design is one artwork, regardless of the size or material it is reproduced at.

designs.name: Chabad Rebbe Poster 1
designs.description: Portrait of the Lubavitcher Rebbe, Menachem Mendel Schneerson, in a black fedora against a yellow ground, captioned in Hebrew יחי אדוננו מורנו ורבינו מלך המשיח לעולם ועד -- commonly shortened to יחי המלך המשיח, 'long live King Messiah'. Some reproductions carry an additional line, ברכה והצלחה ('blessing and success'), above the portrait.
designs.size_note: Reproduced at two very different scales: large wheatpasted sheets on construction hoardings, and small yellow stickers on lampposts and utility boxes. Same artwork, so one identifier.
designs.notes: Observed intact, over-sprayed with black paint, torn, and sun-bleached to near-illegibility. All states are labelled as this design.

not_yet_labelled.description: White and blue sticker, Rebbe portrait, captioned ברוך הבא מלך המשיח ('blessed is the coming King Messiah'). A distinct artwork from poster-1, seen on the same lamppost in 17.29.15. Not yet annotated, so not yet a class.
